Class Asset

java.lang.Object
simscli.asset.Asset
All Implemented Interfaces:
Ownable, Sellable
Direct Known Subclasses:
Car, Hotel, House
public abstract class Asset extends Object implements Ownable, Sellable
Abstract base class for all ownable assets: cars, houses, hotels. Assets have purchase value and can be sold.
